headline: Approved adding 17 classrooms and a natatorium back to the new Wallingford High School plan, 5-4; also approved changes to officer removal and other bylaws.
summary: The meeting covered draft Educational Specifications for the ASTE program at the proposed new Wallingford High School. Members will gather feedback through a Google Form and a community forum. Members also voted 5-4 to add the 17 classrooms and the pool back into the plan and approved several bylaw and policy changes.
decisions: Approved amending the motion to add back the pool (natatorium) and the 17 classrooms, 5-4.
Rescinded the earlier unanimous vote to accept the first set of consent agenda items.
Approved consent agenda items 7.1 through 7.3.4, 7.4, 7.5, 7.10 and 7.15, unanimously.
Approved item 7.3.5, a budget transfer for professional and technical legal fees, 8 in favor, 0 opposed, 1 abstention.
Failed to table the remaining items removed from the consent agenda, 4-5.
Approved amending Policy 9222 to remove “bona fide” and add “any committee chairperson” after officer, 8 in favor, 1 opposed.
Failed to replace “other disciplinary action” in Policy 9222 with the proposed wording, 4-5.
Approved adding “In Consultation with the Board Officer” in two places in Policy 9222, 8 in favor, with Craig absent.
Approved adding “any committee chairpersons” after board officer under the standard for removal in Policy 9222, 9-0.
Approved adding that the board attorney will be present and will develop removal protocol to Policy 9222, 9-0.
Approved Bylaw 9222, Resignation/Removal of Board Officers, with the edits discussed, unanimously.
Approved removing “normally” and adding “bona fide” to Bylaw 9312, unanimously.
Approved Bylaw 9312, Board Policy, with edits, unanimously.
Approved adding “It shall do so upon five affirmative votes” to Bylaw 9313 and approving it with edits, 8 in favor, 1 opposed.
Approved Bylaw 9325.1, Quorum and Voting Procedures, unanimously.
Approved amending and accepting Bylaw 9327.1, Board Member Use of Social Networks, unanimously.
Approved Bylaw 9311, Board Policies, with two edits, unanimously.
Approved Bylaw 9326, Minutes, with two edits, unanimously.
Approved Bylaw 9327, Electronic Mail Communications, with edits, 8 in favor, 1 opposed.
Accepted the resignation of Christina Madancy effective September 19, 2026, unanimously.
No action was taken on the appointment of a candidate to the business manager position.
